info.title: Trading Dashboard API
info.description: Native Nest request DTOs and validated JSON wire responses. Unknown DTO keys are rejected. Query numbers are serialized as strings; empty numeric values are rejected except the documented fills limit fallback. Conditional business constraints (settings revisions, rule parameters and import column semantics) are described on their inputs. Privy bearer tokens identify users; server-owned roles and permissions authorize access. Public favorites queries require a human user. Service tokens cannot act as an owned profile.

bearerAuth.description: Privy access token, or scoped service token where permitted.

expectedRevisions.description: Required for every changed settings section (428 if missing; 409 if stale). Read the revisions from GET /admin/settings.

paramsJson.description: For R1/R3, flatThresholdUsd and pctThreshold must both be finite positive numbers. Other rule-specific semantics are checked by the service.

rows.description: Dynamic column maps; address, ranking and tier semantics are checked by the import service.

avatarUrl.description: https URL; omit to derive from the 𝕏 handle

csv.description: CSV with a header row: address, display_name, x_handle, verified, sort_order[, avatar_url]

replace.description: Remove KOLs the file doesn't list (only when every row is valid)
